text.hi: विराम चिह्न (punctuation): वाक्य बड़े अक्षर (capital) से शुरू होता है और full stop (.) पर ख़त्म। ‘I’ हमेशा capital। रुकने के लिए comma (,)।
text.hinglish: Viraam chihn (punctuation): vaakya bade akshar (capital) se shuru hota hai aur full stop (.) par khatm. ‘I’ hamesha capital. Rukne ke liye comma (,).
text.en: Punctuation: a sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop. ‘I’ is always a capital. Use a comma for a short pause.

text.hi: अब बिखरे शब्दों से वाक्य बनाओ। किताब का उदाहरण: The moon / and / see / with / me / o / come → O! come with me and see the moon.
text.hinglish: Ab bikhre shabdon se vaakya banao. Kitaab ka udaharan: The moon / and / see / with / me / o / come → O! come with me and see the moon.
text.en: Now make sentences from jumbled words. The book's example: The moon / and / see / with / me / o / come → O! come with me and see the moon.
